name: ATAT (Astronomical Transformer for time series And Tabular data), ALeRCE
code_pin: github.com/alercebroker/ATAT commit 0db532f2fd317ae0426b996e22922c11a37984c0 (2026-06-03), shallow clone at code/alercebroker_ATAT
quantity_returned: Per light curve, a 20-way log-softmax over the ELAsTiCC broker taxonomy (datasets.py::classes_names['ELASTICC']). With light curve plus tabular input, three heads are trained (lc token classifier, tab token classifier, MLP over concatenated tokens; layers/encoder_ellastic.py TokenClassifier and ClassifierFeedForward). Selection metric in scripts/general/ELASTICC.json is 'F1Score_MLPMix/val', so the mixed head is the one selected. Input: FLUXCAL difference flux on a padded grid of 65 epochs x 6 ELAsTiCC bands (datasets.py seq_dict=65, channel_dict=6) with alert masks and photometry times, plus optionally 64 header fields mapped in src/data/get_lc_md.py::feat_dict (HOSTGAL/HOSTGAL2 photo-z quantiles, magnitudes, snsep, REDSHIFT_HELIO, MWEBV) after a pretrained QuantileTransformer (joblib files QT-New/md_fold_*.joblib).
defining_paper: Cabrera-Vives et al. 2024, A&A, arXiv:2405.03078v2; full text read (sources/arxiv_2405.03078.txt)
accuracy_against_scored_measurement: UNDEMONSTRATED. The paper reports macro F1 = 82.6 +/- 0.5 (LC+MD+MTA) on a 1000-per-class balanced ELAsTiCC test set (Table 1, Fig 4), which is simulated data. No measurement exists against the benchmark's scored quantity, the spectroscopic class of real transients chosen for follow-up (ZTF BTS / Rubin), and none is possible from the pinned artifacts because the weights were not downloaded or hashed.
what_it_is_not: Not a foundation model with a released embedding API: it is a supervised classifier trained end-to-end on labels. Not trained or validated on real survey data: ELAsTiCC simulation only (paper Sec 2.1 and Sec 4 caveat that ELAsTiCC 'may not [be] representative of the real LSST alert stream'). No ZTF path: no ZTF dataset key in datasets.py. The metadata branch is not a light-curve model: it consumes simulated host-galaxy photo-z quantiles and redshift fields that the Rubin lsst.v11_1 alert packet does not contain (schema/11/1/lsst.v11_1.diaObject.avsc has no host or redshift field). It is not a scorer and cannot take an agent's hypothesis.
conventions: Band set ugrizY with capital Y (ELAsTiCC); the Rubin alert uses band 'y' in diaSource.band

Flux unit is SNANA FLUXCAL (zeropoint 27.5); Rubin psfFlux is in nJy, so a conversion factor is required (fink-science applies 10**(-(31.4-27.5)/2.5) in rubin/snn/processor.py L114; ATAT has no such converter)
Time axis: days since first forced-photometry point (paper Sec 2.2.1); code selects 'time_phot' via --use_time_phot in scripts/searching_e/spec.json
Forced photometry from 30 days before the first alert is included (src/data/get_lc_md.py L120 mask_final[time < t_min - 30.0] = 0)
NaN/inf in features and metadata replaced by -9999 before the quantile transform (src/data/get_qt_feat_and_h5_file.py L178-215)
Masked temporal augmentation draws t* from {8, 128, 2048} days (datasets.py::three_time_mask)
T_max = 1500 days (datasets.py T_max), M = 64 Fourier components (scripts/general/ELASTICC.json)
Class-balanced batches via BalancedBatchSampler oversampling (datasets.py) with --equally_sample

construct_validity_I4: UNDEMONSTRATED. The scored quantity for spectroscopic follow-up allocation is the spectroscopic class (and follow-up value) of a real object. ATAT returns a class posterior under the ELAsTiCC simulation prior with 20 classes, which is adjacent to that quantity but calibrated to a simulated class mix. Its metadata branch cannot be fed from the Rubin packet.
certification_I5: UNDEMONSTRATED (out of scope: no known-input test, negative control, reachability or receipt check was run)
